resources.string: Converted on this phone; nothing is uploaded.
This is an older Office file (.doc, .xls or .ppt) or one locked with a password. Open it in Office or Google Docs, save it as .docx, .xlsx or .pptx, then convert that copy.
Text, headings, lists, tables and pictures are kept. Pages follow A4, so they may break in different places than in Word; text boxes, shapes and charts are not drawn.
Each visible sheet becomes a table with its values. Charts, pictures in cells and colours are not drawn.
Each slide becomes a page with its text and pictures, in slide order. Designs, backgrounds, charts and animations are not drawn.
The text is kept as it is, line for line; CSV files become a table.
The page\'s text, tables and built-in pictures are kept. Nothing is loaded from the internet.
Only the first %1$s slides are converted; the rest are left out.
